h1: 30A Beach House Mia's Beach House at Treetop

description_expanded: Description Description 30A beach house rental, Mia's Beach House, located in Seacrest Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home. This home is within the 30A gated community of Treetop Village. Nestled in the exclusive Treetops neighborhood of Inlet Beach, Mia's Beach House is a stunning 2,553 sq. ft. newly constructed vacation home that flawlessly blends luxury with functionality. Set within a gated community offering direct beach access and a community pool, this custom beach retreat spans three levels of meticulously crafted living space. Step inside and be greeted by European hardwood floors and elegant cypress accent ceilings. The first floor features soaring 10-foot ceilings, setting the stage for two spacious bedrooms, each with its own private ensuite bath. Ascend to the second floor, where the ceiling rises to 12 feet, creating a bright and open atmosphere, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The centerpiece of the home is a gourmet kitchen outfitted with top-of-the-line Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large island with a waterfall edge. The kitchen’s sophisticated design is accentuated by a ceiling-high tiled backsplash and chic black hardware, lending timeless charm. Just off the kitchen, the second-floor terrace is equipped with an outdoor BBQ summer kitchen, perfect for dining al fresco in serene surroundings. This level also features another bedroom with its own ensuite bath. Natural light pours into every corner of the home, highlighting thoughtful details like hand-fabricated custom railings and spacious bedrooms, all boasting ensuite bathrooms. The bathrooms are designed to impress with luxurious floating vanities, under-cabinet lighting, and spa-like frameless glass showers with hand-selected tile. Custom walk-in closets provide ample storage in every bedroom. The third-floor primary suite offers a tranquil retreat with views of the lush nature preserve. Step onto your private balcony to take in the peaceful scenery, a perfect way to begin or end your day. Solid core doors throughout ensure quiet privacy, while the epoxy-coated garage floors add an extra touch of sophistication. Outside, gas lanterns and thoughtfully designed landscape lighting create both beauty and security. Every detail in Mia’s Beach House has been curated to offer an unparalleled experience of coastal luxury. With beach access just moments away and the privacy of a gated community, this is truly the ultimate home away from home. Beach access at this property is Inlet Regional Access. Public parking is available. Tram service is not provided to and from this address. FEATURES * 30A Beach House - Treetop Village * 4 Bedrooms, 4.5 Bathroom* Spacious Balconies * Living Area - 65" Smart TV - Second Floor* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area * Bedroom 1 - King Bed, 50" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Third Floor* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, 50" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Second Floor* Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 50" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - First Floor* Bedroom 4 - Bunk Bed (Full/Full), 50" Smart TV, Atari Arcade Machine, En Suite Bathroom - First Floor * Half Bathroom* Grill * Complimentary High Speed WI-FI* Sleeps 8 Surveillance Device: Please note that there are surveillance cameras on the exterior of this home. 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT TREETOP VILLAGE IN SEACREST, FLThis gated Seacrest community is nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach offering a prime 30A location. The community includes easy access with 2 private entrances off 30A and Hwy 98. Guests will enjoy being within walking distance to all the shops and restaurants at Seacrest, Alys and Rosemary Beach. COMMUNITY AMENITIESPoolWalk to Restaurants and Shops Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less
